posts.excerpt: We got into Y Combinator P26 as some of the youngest Indians ever to get in. The founder names Result (YC P26). The post calls Result the platform for one-to-three-person teams in a post-work economy. Visible metrics: 558 likes, 558 reactions, 49 comments.

We got into Y Combinator (P26). The founder says he is skipping college to build Result. The post reports scaling SimpleClaw to $40k MRR in under three weeks before the Result announcement. Visible metrics: 551 likes, 551 reactions, 37 comments.

We got into Y Combinator (P26) After scaling SimpleClaw to $40k MRR in <3 weeks, we learnt what our users were trying to accomplish - build companies with agents. SimpleClaw is shutting down; I’m now 19, and made the hard decision to skip college to build Result, my biggest bet so far. Company announcement tomorrow. ok, back to work.
